name: Benchmark for filter feature-selection methods
description: An evaluation suite comparing filter-based feature selection methods on high-dimensional classification datasets.
evaluation_method: accuracy (and related classification metrics such as AUC)
reputation: A peer-reviewed methods comparison in the feature-selection literature with moderate recognition among researchers working on high-dimensional classification.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark on high-dimensional, often small-sample datasets (e.g., microarray); results sensitive to class imbalance and choice of downstream classifier; not saturated.
